# The Judge {#sec-the-judge}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "I can eyeball quality" — at scale you cannot, and the demo is
not a test.

Installs: the LLM judge, criteria, thresholds, calibrated distrust;
judging as the baseline literacy of the AI era. Working build:
`judge-your-bot` — score a chatbot's answers against stated criteria
and read where the judge itself disagrees with you.
:::
